notes: Stop Program Change numbers are not published per stop for this model (the manual only says they depend on the number and order of the stops): use Learn every stop. Each stop Program Change toggles the stop.

Check on your organ: the division channels can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu. The manual does not say which channel carries CC11 (expression) or CC7 (general volume): CC11 is assumed on the Swell's channel and CC7 on channel 1.

The Studio has selectable sample styles; some tabs change name with the style. Primary (default) names are used; alternates printed on the website: Great Quintaton 8' / Harmonic Flute 8' (S), Twelfth / Gamba 8' (S), Cornet / Terzian (H); Swell Flute 8' / Rohr Flute 8' (B-H), Wald Flute 2' / Fifteenth 2' (B), Mixture / Carillon (H), Trumpet 8' / Oboe 8' (S-B); Pedal Principal 16' / Flute 16' (S), Choralbass 4' / Flute 4' (S), Mixture / Quintbass (S-H), Trumpet 8' / Clarion 4' (S).
Mixture/Cornet ranks are not published (entered without ranks; Cornet entered at 8').

MIDI scheme: Johannus Studio 280/380 user manual (February 2024), MIDI specifications p. 43 (Studio 280: Great 1, Swell 2, Pedal 3, stops 12; CC11 55-127; CC7 40-127; all stops off F0 00 4A 4F 48 41 53 7F F7): https://hq.globalorgangroup.com/service/scripts/customer.fcgi/getAttachment/47185-OFj15DYZZASjMi8Pu6CMGcg2aZYBALyRHD6Y6FWUbyOHj87aAggnNUS5fDbQnpQJ-0/Studio%20280-380%20Usermanual.pdf
